name: FFS_WMT_THEME
description: Contains Where is my Technician themes.

columns.name: LABEL
columns.description: Unique string identifier of the WMT theme. Used for referencing WMT theme from a message scenario's body.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Contains meaningful description of WMT theme, is available only at the configuration screen.

columns.name: VERSION
columns.description: Indicates version number of the WMT theme. Increments with every update. Used for caches invalidaiton.

columns.name: UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Indicates date and time of most recent WMT theme update.

columns.name: IS_DEFAULT
columns.description: Indicates if this WMT theme is a default WMT theme. Only 1 default WMT theme can be selected.

columns.name: TEMPLATE_LABEL
columns.description: Selected WMT visual template option. Available values: 'theme-bright', 'theme-hero', 'theme-minimal'.

columns.name: PROPERTY_MAPPING
columns.description: Contains mapping of WMT fields scoreProp (feedback rating), commentProp (feedback comment), resourceNameProp (a resource proeprty used to display as a resource's name) to Field Service properties by lable in JSON format.

columns.name: CONTENT
columns.description: WMT theme configuration is JSON format.

columns.name: CUSTOM_DOMAIN_NAME
columns.description: Contains custom domain name to be used by this WMT theme.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: DELETED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the record is logically deleted (Y - soft deleted, N or NULL - active).

columns.name: WMT_THEME_ID
columns.description: Numeric unique ID for a WMT theme.
